3925.title: Project environment lost during skill discovery
3925.rootCauseOneLine: Native-root listing drops project identity and resolves plugin host environment with a null project, excluding project overrides.
3925.proposedFix: Propagate project context and cache scope through listing, and guarantee per-call effective environment isolation in provider host handlers.
3925.caveats: API reproduction uses real database, resolver and scanner with an in-process host responder; no live daemon, terminal, UI or other providers were exercised. No automatic fix: cross-subsystem host/plugin environment contract work exceeds the simple-fix limits. Reproduction source and logs are inline in the HTML, as required by the reports repository publication policy.
